title: CCDN consolidated requirement and evidence audit

paper.title: The dimension growth conjecture, polynomial in the degree and without logarithmic factors

validation.method: Statement-scope review retained through the maintainability refactor (namespace rename, topic directories, declaration renames and deduplication). scripts/audit-evidence.py verifies every evidence location and hash; the full build, axiom audit and sandboxed Comparator with all three kernels pass.

path_convention: Evidence file paths are relative to the repository root. vendor/bombieri-vaaler is the pinned local dependency; .lake/packages/mathlib denotes the Lake-resolved pinned mathlib checkout. No machine-specific absolute paths are used.
model_caveats: Actual coordinate ideals, their quotients/localizations, Hilbert functions and fraction fields are the geometric model. A separate equivalence with Mathlib Scheme/Proj objects has not been claimed or audited.
Local projective hypersurface stalks use actual affine-chart algebraic localizations. This is not an independently formalized Scheme/Proj stalk comparison.

Plucker coordinates use all ordered column injections, hence a signed redundant projective-coordinate model. Centers are actual fixed-dimensional submodules; their Zariski topology is induced by homogeneous principal opens. No binomial target-dimension identification or equality with the earlier row-span quotient topology is claimed.
The literal affine bad-prime factor and the factor including degree loss are distinct. They agree for nonzero homogeneous forms; affine source conclusions use the repaired literal-factor statements.
The Salberger radius-one case uses Lean totalized division in the log-denominator expression, together with a valid finite radius-one count.
Historical survey statements about degrees two through four and alternative proof routes are not dependencies of the recorded main results and are not included as requirements.

For each given field extension, the sharp Plucker complement family is constructed over the source field. No single family uniform over all extensions or scheme-theoretic universal family is asserted.

source_corrections.text: Printed arbitrary-profile n=1 claim is false. For every proposed constant, an actual monotone infinite enumeration with c=1 and g(k)=mu+floor(mu/k), mu=K!, violates it. Restrict general lemma to n>=2; use the separately proved hypersurface n=1 bound. Not in author addenda dated 2026-04-20.

Printed individually homogeneous columns need a common degree, or chart-normalized evaluations. Formal family on X2=0 with primitive (i+1,p,0) and columns X0^j refutes any uniform O(s) error in the literal unnormalized local assertion. Not an author-published correction.

Author addenda corrects n+1 variables to n+2. The proof also requires the common-degree repair of 2.5; the repository does not claim the unrestricted unnormalized variant. No separate formal negation of the exact 2.6 expression was inspected.
Same common-degree restriction as repaired 2.5/2.6. The unnormalized varying-degree form is not established; the separately refuted global 3.2.6 cannot be recovered from it.

Literal unrestricted differing-degree formulation is formally false even for L=1 on the primitive absolutely irreducible line X2=0 with b(f)=1. Require common degree within each square matrix, or redesign the globally normalized evaluations; prime-dependent chart normalization alone does not give one integral gcd.

Printed intermediate equality of literal affine and homogeneous bad-prime factors fails; chart determinant proof supplies the literal conclusion independently. CCDN/Counterexample/HomogenizedBadPrimeFactor.lean refutes the equality formally: for 439*x^2+y the literal factor is 1 while that of its homogenization is 439^(1/439), and products of primes above 432 make the ratio unbounded.
Uses the repaired literal-factor auxiliary rather than the false homogenization-factor equality.
Author addenda 2026-04-20 strengthens irreducibility of top form to absolute irreducibility. Literal weaker printed hypothesis is not claimed.
Author addenda replaces printed d^14 with d^18.

Literal m=0,d=1 strict degree<1 is formally refuted. Valid replacement is degree<=1. The positive-dimensional bound is proved by a generic-line derivative resultant; the printed Noether composition calculation does not give that bound.
